title: Apparel Designer
description:
Company Description

Founded in Los Angeles in 2023, BioBlanks is an end-to-end sustainable manufacturing platform leveraging innovative practices to create custom apparel for modern businesses and creators. It is no secret that "swag" and "merch" has become synonymous with cheap and undesirable clothing to be worn once and never thought of again. We spent the past 3 years building a proprietary process in downtown Los Angeles to create apparel that rivals your favorite luxury brand while ensuring that the garments are kind to the earth. We use traceable organic materials, low-impact dyes, and regenerative manufacturing methods to ensure our customers not only love our merch, but the earth does as well. And the best part? We handle every step from design, sourcing, production, and delivery to make sure our clients can stay focused on what they do best—building a killer brand.


Job Responsibilities

  • Lead design projects from initial concept through final production-ready files, bringing creative ideas to client briefs while ensuring every detail meets our quality standards.
  • Collaborate closely with clients and internal teams to translate their vision into compelling apparel graphics, incorporating feedback throughout the design process.
  • Prepare and finalize all artwork for production, including proper file formats, export settings, and color specifications for print.
  • Maintain organized project documentation in Notion and Google Drive, including technical sheets, status updates, and asset libraries.
  • Contribute to brainstorms and creative sessions with fresh ideas that push beyond conventional approaches to apparel design.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve design workflows, templates, and processes as the company scales.


Hard Skills

  • Proficient in vector and raster-based graphics
  • Experience in traditional illustration (hand-drawing)
  • Proficient in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and Figma, including export settings, preparation for print, and required file formats (required)
  • Proficient in web-based tools such as Notion, Google Drive, and Google Sheets
  • 3+ years experience as a graphic designer (required)
  • 2+ years experience as an apparel designer (preferred)
  • Experience working with clients and managing projects (required)
  • Experience with color separation of artwork for printing (preferred)
  • Experience in a startup, agency, or small company environment (preferred)
  • Proficient English fluency (preferred)
  • Intermediate English fluency (required)


Soft Skills

  • Self-starter who takes initiative without needing to be asked
  • Excited to solve problems creatively and think outside the box
  • Strong team player and contributor to company culture
  • Low ego—open to feedback and willing to adapt
  • Not afraid to make mistakes and sees them as opportunities to improve
  • Obsessed with aesthetics and visual design
  • Highly curious with good taste and references within the creative arts
  • Highly productive with strong organizational skills
  • Clear and responsive communicator
  • Passionate about pursuing excellence in all work
  • Thrives on collaboration and constructive feedback
  • Responsible and reliable
  • Wants to grow with a company long-term and build from the ground up


Compensation & Job Information

  • Full-Time (40 hours weekly)
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Monthly wellness stipend
  • Paid biweekly · Contractor

title: Full Stack Mobile Developer
description:
About the Role  

I am supporting a US healthcare client in hiring a Full-Stack Mobile Developer to take end-to-end ownership of their flagship mobile application. In this role, you will serve as the sole mobile developer , responsible for evolving an app that pairs with a Bluetooth-enabled pulse oximeter ring to capture overnight sleep data and securely upload it to the cloud.


You won’t be working in isolation—while you’ll lead all mobile-focused design and development, you’ll collaborate closely with a team of experienced C#/.NET backend engineers. You’ll also contribute to backend features related to sleep-study processing and data workflows, helping shape the overall product experience from device integration through clinical-grade data analysis.


This is an opportunity to own a critical mobile product in a modern health-tech environment, working with senior engineers to deliver technology that directly impacts patient outcomes. The ideal candidate will have expertise in both mobile development (Flutter/Dart) and backend technologies (C#/.NET), and be capable of ensuring seamless device integration, reliable overnight data collection, and robust backend connectivity with Azure services. 

Key Responsibilities  


  • Lead the development and maintenance of cross-platform mobile applications using Flutter/Dart for iOS and Android. 
  • Implement and optimize Bluetooth connectivity with the ring pulse oximeter device. 
  • Address Android battery optimization challenges to guarantee reliable overnight data collection. 
  • Manage the release process for both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store. 
  • Collaborate with backend developers on Azure-hosted .NET services, contributing to backend development when required. 
  • Ensure compliance with health data security and privacy standards. 
  • Work independently while providing technical leadership within the team. 


Requirements  


  • Professional level English comprehension (spoken, reading/writing)
  • 7+ years of professional software development experience, with strong expertise in mobile development. 
  • Proven experience with Flutter/Dart  for cross-platform mobile applications. 
  • Working knowledge of C# and .NET , with the ability to contribute to backend services. 
  • Deep understanding of Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE)  implementation. 
  • Experience with Android battery optimization techniques  for background processes. 
  • Successful track record of publishing and maintaining apps in the App Store and Google Play. 
  • Experience integrating with Microsoft Azure services . 
  • Familiarity with Firebase  (Authentication, Crashlytics, Analytics), Sentry , and PostHog . 
  • Advanced English communication skills (C1 level ), both written and spoken. 
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail. 
  • Prior experience in health or medical app development is a plus. 

Technical Skills  


  • Primary:  Flutter/Dart, Bluetooth LE, iOS, Android 
  • Secondary:  C#, .NET, Azure, Firebase 
  • Tools:  GitHub, Sentry, PostHog, App Store Connect, Google Play Console 


What We Offer  


  • The opportunity to develop innovative health technology with real impact. 
  • Competitive salary based on experience. 
  • Professional growth and development opportunities. 
  • A collaborative team culture that values independence and initiative.

description:

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

title: Platform Engineer
description:
Platform Engineer (AWS / Terraform / Kafka) – Fintech Payments Platform

Location: Remote (UK/EU time zones)

Contract: 7 months (to April 2026)


Start: ASAP

Tech Stack: AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes/EKS, Kafka, GitOps, Cloud-Native Tooling

Focus: Platform engineering & solution build (not ops/DevOps)


About the Role

We’re looking for a Platform Engineer to join a major UK retail group building a new Klarna-style fintech payments platform. This role sits at the heart of the cloud platform team and focuses on designing, building, and automating the core infrastructure that powers high-scale financial transactions.

You’ll work in a highly technical environment, collaborating with architects, backend engineers, and security teams to deliver secure, resilient, cloud-native foundations. This is a hands-on build role — not day-to-day ops or DevOps support.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Build & Infrastructure Engineering

  • Design and implement scalable, resilient cloud platform components in AWS
  • Own Infrastructure as Code using Terraform (modular, reusable architectures)
  • Build secure multi-account AWS environments following Well-Architected principles
  • Develop internal platform tooling, automation, templates, and golden paths
  • Support EKS/Kubernetes environments and microservice deployment foundations

Event-Driven & Distributed Architecture

  • Build and support Kafka-based event streaming and messaging capabilities
  • Ensure high availability, reliability, and idempotent service patterns
  • Work with engineers to define infrastructure for distributed, real-time systems

Observability, Reliability & Performance

  • Implement monitoring, alerting, logging, and distributed tracing (Datadog/Grafana/ELK)
  • Ensure SLAs/SLOs for platform components are met
  • Contribute to disaster recovery design, multi-region readiness, and resilience testing

Security, Governance & Compliance

  • Enforce best practices for IAM, secrets management, encryption, and network security
  • Build guardrails, policies, and automated compliance into CI/CD and IaC workflows
  • Contribute to platform risk assessments and mitigation strategies

Collaboration & Technical Leadership

  • Partner with architects, platform leads, and product teams to translate requirements into technical designs
  • Work with developers to guide best practices for cloud-native builds
  • Mentor engineers in IaC, automation, and platform engineering patterns

Skills & Experience

Essential

  • 5+ years in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, or Infrastructure Engineering
  • Strong experience with AWS (multi-account, networking, security, core services)
  • Excellent Terraform skills, building modular and production-grade IaC
  • Solid understanding of Kubernetes / EKS or similar orchestration platforms
  • Experience with Kafka or other event-streaming technologies
  • Hands-on with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, ArgoCD)
  • Strong understanding of monitoring, distributed tracing, and observability
  • Ability to work autonomously in fast-paced, cloud-native engineering teams

Nice to Have

  • Experience in fintech, payments, or high-throughput distributed systems
  • Knowledge of Well-Architected Framework, security engineering, compliance
  • Familiarity with service mesh, API gateways, or serverless components
  • Exposure to Python/Go/TypeScript for automation or tooling

What This Role is Not

  • Not day-to-day ops or support
  • Not traditional DevOps or SRE maintenance
  • Not basic provisioning or infra monitoring
  • Not a junior cloud role

This is a platform build position: architecture + IaC + automation + infrastructure foundations.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:

We’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to help one of our new partners build a next-generation AI product from the ground up. title: Analista de Dados Sênior
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

  • Traduzir problemas de negócios em termos analíticos e facilitar tomadas de decisão para resolução destes problemas;
  • Propor pró-ativamente soluções técnicas e de negócio;
  • Ser pró-ativo na garantia de segurança e privacidade dos dados, cumprindo regulamentações.


Requisitos:

  • Formação em tecnologia, ciências exatas/biológicas com foco em tecnologia ou experiência comprovada na área de banco de dados;
  • Experiência em Data Analytics, Big Query/Databricks;
  • Conhecimento Avançado em análise de dados e estatística intermediário (Amostragem, Teste de Hipótese, Inferência).
  • SQL (DQL, DDL) Avançado.;
  • Conhecimento Intermediário linguagens como JavaScript, Python ou R. Experiencia em extração de dados, ingestão e transformação;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de BI (Tableau, Power BI).


Nossos benefícios:

title: ML/Data Science Lead
description:
About the Product:

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose:

The Data Science Lead will be responsible for defining the strategic vision, leading the development, and overseeing the deployment of advanced machine learning models and data-driven products. This senior role will specifically focus on student audience segmentation, predictive propensity modeling, and AI-enabled career advising. The Lead will manage a team of data scientists and engineers, directing the creation and maintenance of robust, scalable data pipelines and analytical solutions to significantly enhance student engagement, career outcomes, and overall institutional effectiveness.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Data Science Strategy and Team Leadership
  • Lead, mentor, and manage a team of ML/Data Scientists, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous improvement.
  • Define the technical roadmap and best practices for all data science initiatives, focusing on model reliability, fairness, and interpretability.
  • Direct the design, development, and implementation of high-impact data products, especially those focused on segmentation and propensity models.
  • Advanced Model and Algorithm Development
  • Design, develop, and implement machine learning models and algorithms for complex student audience analysis and AI-enabled career advising, with a strong focus on predicting student behavior and optimizing engagement strategies.
  • Oversee the utilization of advanced machine learning techniques, including predictive modeling, recommendation systems, and natural language processing.
  • Establish rigorous processes for model evaluation, optimization, and monitoring in production environments.
  • Develop and maintain robust, scalable data pipelines to support all phases of the ML lifecycle.
  • Data Product Development
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate strategic requirements into data product features.
  • Direct the building and maintenance of data-centric applications and tools that leverage machine learning insights.
  • Implement and manage MLOps and CI/CD workflows for efficient model and data product deployments.
  • Ensure data governance, quality, and integrity across all analytical solutions.
  • Collaboration and Communication
  • Serve as the primary technical conduit among executive business leads, product management, and data/engineering teams.
  • Facilitate demos, strategic reviews, knowledge-sharing sessions, and best-practice documentation.
  • Drive the adoption of new data science capabilities and gather feedback for continuous strategic alignment.
  • Release and Change Management
  • Coordinate comprehensive release plans, timelines, and stakeholder readiness for ML model and data product deployments.
  • Ensure training, job aids, and rollout communications are prepared and delivered effectively.
  • Track and report on post-release issues, adoption metrics, and stabilization progress.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Proven ability to set technical direction, produce high-quality work, manage autonomously, and take strategic initiative.
  • Strong business acumen with unwavering ethics and a willingness to lead by example.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills, cultural competency, and ability to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people and in executive roles.
  • Willingness to embrace relational nuances, own personal mistakes, be empathetic, address conflicts directly and transparently, and commit to self-reflection and self-betterment.
  • Dexterity to effectively deal with ambiguity, change, and continuous process improvements at a strategic level.
  • Strong business analysis fundamentals: elicitation, documentation, process mapping, traceability, UAT.


Requirements:

  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in machine learning engineering, data science, or a related analytical/leadership role within SaaS, marketing technology, higher ed tech, or related domains.
  • Demonstrated experience in managing and mentoring a team of data scientists or ML engineers.
  • Expert-level experience building and deploying segmentation and propensity models in a commercial setting.
  • Familiarity with machine learning frameworks and libraries (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn).
  • Experience with data manipulation and analysis using Python (e.g., Pandas, NumPy).
  • Experience with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., BigQuery, Redshift, GCS, S3).
  • Proficiency in SQL for complex data querying and manipulation.
  • Experience with Git and Git providers (e.g., GitHub, BitBucket, GitLab).
  • Deep understanding of statistical analysis, experimental design, and A/B testing methodologies.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with media modeling audiences and digital lookalike techniques.
  • Experience with natural language processing (NLP) techniques and tools.
  • Familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Matplotlib, Seaborn).
  • Knowledge of educational technology or career development domains.


Credentials and Experience:

  • PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
  • Minimum of 10 years in machine learning engineering, data science, or a related analytical/leadership role within SaaS, marketing technology, higher ed tech, or related domains.

  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), and a flexible work schedule.

title: Copywriter Sênior
description:
A Be Neo é uma marca que funciona nos EUA e que une ciência, performance e branding para transformar a longevidade em um estilo de vida. Nascemos na intersecção entre telemedicina, tecnologia e nutrição de alta performance e nossa missão é elevar o padrão de comunicação em saúde, tornando-a inspiradora. Aqui, copy não é só texto, é estratégia, é persuasão com propósito, é o que conecta pessoas a um futuro mais saudável. 


Sua missão como Copywriter será ser o arquiteto das palavras que constroem a voz da Be Neo. Transformar complexidade médica em histórias que vendem, emocionam e constroem confiança. Você vai liderar a frente criativa de comunicação e performance, com liberdade para testar, propor e criar narrativas que movem o funil de ponta a ponta. 


Buscamos um profissional sênior com visão estratégica , maturidade criativa e domínio absoluto de performance . Alguém que já passou pela fase da pura execução, sabe o que é CAC, LTV, CTR e CPM, mas também entende de alma, timing e branding. Buscamos alguém que viva copywriting como ofício, não como ocupação. Queremos um cérebro criativo com espírito de growth hacker e coração de storyteller . 


Requisitos indispensáveis:

• 3 a 5 anos de experiência comprovada em copywriting de performance, atuando com funis diretos de venda (VSLs, advertoriais, quizzes e upsells);

• Histórico em marcas DTC brasileiras ou telehealth (Dr. Nature, Blivo, VitaScience, Manual, Omens, Bluee, etc.);

• Vivência com operações de tráfego direto, nutracêuticos, times médicos, influenciadores e campanhas multicanal (Meta, Google, TikTok, Native, YouTube);

• Inglês avançado, com capacidade de leitura e comunicação em ambiente profissional internacional.


Skills que procuramos:

• Domínio das estruturas de VSL, advertorial, quiz e upsell, com foco em baixo CAC e alto LTV;

• Capacidade de escrever para múltiplos canais e contextos como Meta Ads, Google, TikTok, Native, Email, SMS, YouTube, Amazon;

• Conhecimento das guidelines de 10DLC, FTC e restrições médicas;

• Leitura e adaptação de dados de performance para otimizar mensagens e headlines com base em resultados reais;

• Capacidade de defender suas ideias com lógica e embasamento, não apenas instinto.


Diferenciais que nos conectam:

• Já ter sido referência de copy em marcas de alta performance ou telehealth;

• Ter vivido o ciclo completo: concepção → lançamento → escala;

• Experiência real com múltiplos canais de tráfego (Meta, TikTok, Native, Google, YouTube);

• Experiência em projetos com médicos, especialistas ou influenciadores de saúde;

• Participação da estruturação de times criativos ou projetos do zero;

• Sede por testar, aprender e evoluir, sendo o tipo de pessoa que se anima com cada CTR que melhora;

• Mentalidade estrategista, não apenas de executor;

• Habilidades de comunicação e argumentação claras;

• Capacidade de colaborar com times diversos, unindo curiosidade, foco em resultados e disposição genuína para evolução pessoal/profissional.


Trabalhar na Be Neo é entrar em um movimento que está mudando o jogo.

Aqui, você participa da expansão de uma marca que une propósito, performance e inteligência, atuando lado a lado com líderes que realmente dominam growth e criatividade. E o melhor: você terá espaço real para deixar sua marca, com liberdade, responsabilidade e visibilidade.

Se você domina narrativa e acredita em um futuro onde saúde, inovação e cuidado humano caminham juntos, essa oportunidade pode ser pra você!

title: Industrial Director
description:
Industrial Director/Plant Director – Leading Global Tier-1 Automotive Systems Supplier

Greater Campinas

Please note: Given the complexity of this mandate, only candidates with proven plant leadership experience in Tier-1 auto parts environments will be considered.


About the Role


We are seeking a highly capable operations/industrial executive to assume the role of Industrial Director , leading a complex Tier-1 auto parts manufacturing site through a structured operational turnaround and long-term performance transformation.


This is an opportunity for an experienced Plant Manager , Senior Industrial Manager , or Industrial/Operations Director ready to step into a broader, strategic leadership role in a high-performance, global environment.


The context involves operational transformation, focusing on stabilizing processes, developing and strengthening teams, improving KPIs, and elevating manufacturing discipline.


Key Responsibilities


  • Lead all plant operations across Production, Engineering, Maintenance, Quality, HSE, Supply Chain, HR, and CI.
  • Conduct a holistic diagnostic of operational gaps and drive a structured operational recovery plan.
  • Implement initiatives focused on process stability, cost efficiency, scrap/yield improvement, reliability, and labor productivity.
  • Build and reinforce leadership capabilities across the plant, promoting a culture of accountability, rigor, and continuous improvement.
  • Drive Lean, TPM, and other operational excellence methodologies with rigor and sustainability.
  • Ensure compliance with global standards in Quality, Safety, Governance, and ESG.
  • Manage stakeholder interactions with customers, suppliers, corporate functions, and global engineering teams.
  • Oversee KPIs, budgets, capex initiatives, and customer deliverables.


Mandatory Qualifications & Experience


  • Strong background in Tier-1 auto parts manufacturing (mandatory).
  • Experience in operational turnaround or performance recovery (e.G., process variability, quality issues, productivity challenges, organizational capability gaps).
  • Proven leadership of large teams in high-complexity, fast-paced industrial environments.
  • Solid foundation in Lean, CI, TPM, or equivalent methodologies.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field (required).
  • Advanced/Fluent English.


Leadership Profile


We are looking for a leader who combines strategic clarity with hands-on discipline, capable of stabilizing operations, developing teams, and delivering sustained performance improvement in a demanding tier-1 auto parts environment. Someone who thrives under complexity, communicates transparently, and brings operational rigor to daily execution.


If you bring the ability to set strategic direction while staying close to the shop floor and combine strategic clarity with real operational depth in demanding Tier-1 environments this is the kind of opportunity where your leadership can truly move the needle.

  • Suportar os times com análise de dados, interpretando métricas e apresentando insights que orientem ações de marketing, comunicação e vendas;
  • Transformar processos manuais em fluxos autônomos de coleta, enriquecimento e ativação de dados — do first touch ao churn prevention;
  • Traduzir métricas em storytelling executivo, capacitar times internos e institucionalizar governança e qualidade dos dados;
  • Monitorar o desempenho de modelos e automações, ajustando prompts, parâmetros e consumo de recursos para garantir qualidade, velocidade e custo-benefício.


Requisitos e Perfil:


  • Graduação concluída há pelo menos 2 anos em Engenharia de Dados, Engenharia de TI, Engenharia de Computação ou Ciência de Dados;
  • Conhecimento emSQL, Python e fundamentos de machine learning;
  • Experiência comprovada em Power BI ou Looker Studio (modelagem, DAX/LookML, publicação);
  • Inglês técnico;
  • Interesse por cybersecurity.


Diferenciais:


  • Projetos de IA em produção - documentação do problema, stack utilizada e impacto gerado;
  • Projetos com LLMs, LangChain, RAG ou chatbots;
  • Certificações PL-300 (Power BI Data Analyst), DP-100 (Azure Machine Learning Engineer) ou Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer;
  • Vivência com dados de segurança da informação ou SaaS B2B.
  • Experiência com MLOps, incluindo CI/CD de modelos e monitoramento de drift.


Sobre a UPX:


Com mais de 22 anos de atuação, a UPX é referência em cibersegurança e performance digital, protegendo ambientes críticos com atuação 24x7.

Especialistas em mitigação de ataques DDoS, prevenção de incidentes e entrega de conteúdo com alta performance, atendemos grandes players dos setores financeiro, bancário, operadoras e ISPs — no Brasil e nos EUA.

Contamos com unidades em Campinas (SP) e Miami (EUA), além de uma estrutura robusta com times técnicos de elite em Segurança da Informação, Engenharia de Redes, SOC, NOC e Scrubbing Centers.

Na UPX, trabalhamos todos os dias para tornar a internet mais segura, confiável e eficiente para empresas e pessoas.

title: Production Supervisor/Coordinator - Dry-Mix Mortar & Water-Based Coatings Factory
description:
Core Responsibilities:

1. Production Operations & Management

  • Oversee daily production management for both dry-mix mortar and water-based coatings lines. Schedule production tasks according to plan, ensuring production targets are met on time, in quantity, and to quality standards.
  • Supervise the entire production process from material preparation, feeding, and mixing to packaging and palletizing, ensuring smooth and efficient operations at all stages.
  • Strictly execute the production schedule, optimize production cycle times, and improve equipment utilization and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).

2. Team Management & Development

  • Manage daily shift operations, including personnel scheduling, task assignment, work guidance, and on-site discipline supervision.
  • Organize and implement job skill training to enhance team members' operational skills, quality awareness, and safety mindset.
  • Conduct performance evaluations for shift personnel, providing continuous feedback and coaching to build a high-performance team.

3. Quality Management & Control

  • Strictly enforce standard operating procedures and work instructions to ensure process standardization and stability.
  • Monitor in-line product quality, perform regular checks at key quality control points, and prevent the occurrence of batch quality issues.
  • Collaborate with the Quality department to analyze, address, and track quality deviations in production, and implement corrective and preventive actions.

4. Safety Production & 5S Management

  • Act as the primary safety responsible person for the shift, implementing company safety rules and regulations, organizing safety training, and conducting hazard identification.
  • Ensure all employees strictly adhere to safe operating procedures, particularly those related to dust explosion prevention and chemical handling, to eliminate safety accidents.
  • Promote and maintain 5S management in the production area, creating a clean, orderly, and safe working environment.

5. Cost Control & Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor and analyze the consumption of raw materials, energy, and auxiliary supplies, striving to reduce production costs.
  • Assist in analyzing equipment failure causes to reduce unplanned downtime.
  • Proactively identify waste in the production process, actively participate in and lead continuous improvement activities (e.G., Kaizen), and propose合理化建议 (rationalization suggestions).

Mandatory Requirements:

  • College diploma or above in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Inorganic Non-metallic Materials, or related fields.
  • Minimum 5 years of production experience in the building materials industry, including at least 2 years in a Production Team Leader or Supervisor role. Must have production management experience in a dry-mix mortar or water-based coatings factory.
  • Familiar with the production processes, equipment principles, and operational procedures for dry-mix mortar/coatings (e.G., mixers, automatic packing machines, powder conveying systems, liquid mixing & dispersing equipment).
  • Strong team leadership, communication, coordination, and on-site problem-solving skills.
  • Strong quality awareness, cost consciousness, and safety mindset.
  • Ability to adapt to a factory work environment and handle work pressure.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior work experience with Sika or Saint-Gobain is highly preferred.

Como Analista de Cobrança e Retenção, você será responsável por conduzir o relacionamento com clientes em momentos críticos do ciclo, especialmente em situações de inadimplência, desalinhamento de expectativas ou perda momentânea de percepção de valor.


Seu papel é estratégico: garantir que o cliente mantenha clareza sobre seu plano de crescimento, entenda os próximos passos e execute corretamente a jornada para renovar e recomprar com previsibilidade.


Nesta função, você atuará com abordagem consultiva, combinando princípios de Customer Success, operações de cobrança, recuperação de crédito e gestão de objeções, sempre com foco na manutenção da receita e saúde da carteira.

  • Conduzir contatos ativos e receptivos com clientes em atraso, risco de churn ou perda de percepção de valor.

  • Resgatar a visão estratégica do cliente, conectando o plano contratado aos resultados esperados.
  • Estruturar negociações e acordos financeiros que permitam continuidade saudável do contrato.
  • Controlar objeções com técnica e empatia, garantindo que o cliente se sinta acompanhado e orientado.
  • Executar rotinas de cobrança consultiva, evitando processos mecânicos e focando no impacto do plano no negócio do cliente.
  • Acompanhar SLAs de contatos, follow-ups, acordos e compromissos assumidos.
  • Mapear riscos de cancelamento e agir preventivamente para evitar churn.
  • Alimentar o CRM com histórico, status, acordos e próximos passos, mantendo previsibilidade e organização.
  • Colaborar com times internos (CS, financeiro, comercial e operações) na construção de rotinas que melhorem retenção e adimplência.
  • Gerar percepções qualitativas sobre comportamento dos clientes, objeções recorrentes e oportunidades de melhoria no produto/atendimento.


Competências desejadas

  • Comunicação clara e empática: saber conduzir conversas difíceis sem perder a conexão.

  • Organização e precisão: registrar dados e cumprir processos com excelência.
  • Visão sistêmica: enxergar a jornada completa do cliente e o impacto da retenção na empresa.

title: Engenheiro Mecânico
description:
Mechanical Engineering


Looking for:

We are looking for a motivated and hands-on Mechanical Engineer to join our team. This position

will provide you with the opportunity to work on exciting development projects, helping to create and

bring innovative products to life. You will apply your experience in mechanical design, CAD modeling,

prototyping, while working alongside cross-functional teams to ensure the product meets all

requirements from concept to production.

The Mechanical Engineer Reporting to the Staff (USA), Engineer out of Campinas.


The Candidate:

You have experience engineering new products and/or handling touchpoints throughout the

concept to manufacturing journey. You’ve either built or supported bringing new products to the

world, handling mechanical engineering design, research, testing, prototyping, and validation.

You have experience working with mass manufactured product and are familiar with a variety of

materials. You’re willing to research, learn, adapt and take initiative but not afraid of taking on

challenges.

The Qualifications :

  • 3+ years of experience in product development and mechanical engineering. Must have a portfolio with previously launched and manufactured products.
  • Proven experience within consumer electronics /household appliance industry and related industries focused on mechanical engineering
  • Engineering degree preferably Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
  • Highly proficient and deeply familiar with CAD tools (Solidworks, Onshape, or Creo) and prior experience with a variety of prototyping approaches
  • Hands-on experience with prototyping, 3D printing, or other fabrication tools is a plus.
  • Experience with a wide range of materials (plastics, metals, rubbers) and knowledge informing the material selection process.
  • Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach challenges methodically applying analytical skills with proactive issue resolution- creating and guiding root cause analysis and DOE’s.
  • Passion for product development: Interest in consumer product design, manufacturing, and mechanical systems.
  • Strong communication skills: Ability to work well with cross-functional teams and convey technical concepts clearly. Strong Presentation skills - especially conveying technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Excellent project management skills- with experience tracking numerous development projects simultaneously.
  • Ability to travel to Asia including Hong Kong, China, Vietnam, South Korea, and Taiwan.
  • Ability to work in English


The Job:

As Mechanical Engineer, you will:

  • Help to lead (and lead) development work from product definition through manufacturing.
  • Communicate progress to team members and project requirements for development and manufacturing.
  • Work closely with NYC and Asia teams to communicate and determine direction & solve development problems as they arise.
  • Collaborate with NY/Asia engineering teams to ensure the engineering designs meet client requirements and design intent.

The Responsibilities:

  • Assist and lead Mechanical Design: Support the design and development of product by creating 3D CAD models, producing engineering drawings, and necessary documentation. i.E. lead mechanical design engineering of a product from inception to manufacturing.
  • Prototyping & Testing: Build and test prototypes to validate designs, including hands-on assembly and working with external suppliers for prototype development.
  • Ensure efficient product development cycle with detailed prototyping, testing, and validation throughout the process.
  • Ensuring designs align with performance, material, and cost targets determined for each project.
  • Collaborate with Teams: Work closely with the engineering and design teams to ensure that products meet functional, material, and aesthetic goals. Communicate with marketing, operations, and manufacturing teams to align on project updates and requirements.
  • Support and Create Documentation: Assist with maintaining and updating CAD models and related product documentation (3D, 2D, etc.).
  • Product Testing: Help conduct off-tool and in-market sample testing, participate in troubleshooting and debugging design issues, and recommend improvements.
  • Learn from Experienced Engineers: Continue to build experience in various materials and different stages of product development while learning best practices from senior and staff engineers.
  • Support Supply Chain Efforts: Collaborate with the sourcing and supply chain teams to help gather information and support procurement of materials and components.
  • Providing technical feedback and assets to support sourcing & supply chain teams, working closely with manufacturing engineers and suppliers.
  • Handle multiple projects and work independently.
  • Provide Engineering Support and Analysis to NY and HK engineering teams.
  • Build inhouse prototypes or scope external partners to prototype designs.

  • Habilidade com planilhas e ferramentas de automação de relatórios (Google Sheets, Excel, Power BI, entre outros);

  • Boa comunicação interpessoal e capacidade de integração com diferentes áreas da empresa.

Diferenciais

title: Especialista Contábil
description:
Vaga: Especialista Contábil

Estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista Contábil para integrar nosso time! Procuramos um profissional com experiência sólida na área contábil, tributária e societária, que tenha perfil analítico, atenção aos detalhes e capacidade de liderar processos e equipe.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Realizar escrituração e classificação contábil conforme normas do CFC.
  • Efetuar conciliações bancárias e correções de divergências.
  • Elaborar demonstrações financeiras (Balanço Patrimonial, DRE, DFC e DMPL).
  • Analisar informações contábeis, identificando tendências, riscos e oportunidades.
  • Apurar tributos (IRPJ, CSLL, PIS, COFINS, ICMS, ISS, IPI etc.).
  • Elaborar e entregar obrigações acessórias (EFD, DCTF, SPED, DIRF etc.) dentro dos prazos legais.
  • Desenvolver estratégias de planejamento tributário e recuperação de créditos.
  • Apoiar auditorias e fiscalizações de órgãos governamentais.
  • Implementar controles internos e melhorias em processos.
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais para suporte à gestão.
  • Atuar em processos de licitações e tratativas contábeis junto ao setor público.
  • Aplicar critérios contábeis relacionados à Lei do Bem (P&D).
  • Liderar, orientar e supervisionar a equipe contábil e fiscal, garantindo prazos e qualidade nas entregas.

Requisitos

  • Graduação em Ciências Contábeis, com CRC ativo.
  • Pós-graduação completa ou em andamento em áreas correlatas.
  • Curso em Reforma Tributária.
  • Excel avançado e boas habilidades em informática.

Experiência Necessária

  • Atuação em contabilidade geral, tributária e societária.
  • Experiência no setor de prestação de serviços (Lucro Presumido e Real).
  • Elaboração de relatórios gerenciais e indicadores.
  • Atendimento a fiscalizações e órgãos reguladores.
  • Implantação e utilização de ERP (preferencialmente Protheus – TOTVS).
  • Suporte em processos de due diligence e compliance.
  • Gestão de equipe e de prazos para obrigações acessórias.

Conhecimentos Específicos

  • Domínio da legislação tributária brasileira (IR, CSLL, PIS, COFINS, ISS etc.).
  • Conhecimento avançado em obrigações acessórias (EFD Fiscal, EFD Contribuições, DCTF etc.).
  • Familiaridade com processos de licitações e tratativas junto ao setor público.

About the job

1. About Us

We are a leading global technology company operating in the high-growth sector of On-Demand Consumer Services. Leveraging innovative technology and proven strategies from a global digital commerce leader, we are driving massive international expansion. We offer a challenging, fast-paced environment and an unparalleled opportunity to build and scale a business from the ground up in new markets.

2. Responsibilities

  • Team Building and Empowerment: Assist our organization in establishing a local sales team, building from scratch to drive business expansion. Rapidly enhance the team's capabilities and ensure the achievement of business goals through systematic one-on-one and group training models.
  • System Development and Optimization: Establish and maintain smooth internal and external communication channels. Continuously optimize team operational mechanisms based on different stages of business development to strengthen the team's professional expertise.
  • Cultural Integration and Team Building: Demonstrate the ability to manage multicultural teams effectively and build a high-performance team that aligns with the company's core values.
  • Goal Setting and Alignment: Combine senior leadership requirements with the team's actual situation, conduct comprehensive assessments and provide feedback, clarify work objectives, and set phased goals according to timelines.
  • Process Management and Tracking: Utilize a mature Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) framework to ensure smooth operations at the frontline. Adjust strategies promptly based on business progress to ensure process management meets requirements.
  • Outcome Achievement and Review: Ensure work objectives are achieved successfully. Conduct reviews of work processes, explore more efficient methods, summarize experiences, and accumulate valuable insights for future work.
  • Time Management and Optimization: Clearly define time management priorities for the role and different levels, and optimize personal time management based on actual circumstances.

3. Basic Requirements

  • Management Experience: Proven experience in managing sales teams, with outstanding performance in a high-growth company over the past years.
  • Team Leadership Methods: Ability to clearly articulate methods for leading teams to success, with proven, replicable experience in overseas markets.
  • Experience Sharing: Actively share work experiences and provide actionable improvement suggestions to help the team quickly enhance their capabilities.
  • Strategic Thinking: Possess a holistic mindset with the ability to clearly plan business and team development pathways. When facing challenges, accurately identify root causes and coordinate between global headquarters and various teams to resolve issues swiftly.
  • Focus on Talent Development: Prioritize talent growth, having previously served as a corporate trainer or established a training system within the team.
  • Motivation and Resilience: Demonstrate strong ambition and professionalism, willingness to challenge oneself, and the ability to handle work-related pressure effectively.
  • Language Proficiency: Fluent in English (speaking, listening, reading, and writing), with the ability to adapt to long-term overseas work.

4. Job Highlights

Join us to witness the rapid growth of a global digital giant's international business expansion and experience firsthand the industry transformation and growth miracles. You will collaborate with a world-class, diverse team, fostering innovative thinking, expanding your international perspective, and deepening your expertise. This is not just a job—it's an unparalleled opportunity to achieve personal growth, realize your self-worth, and drive global business innovation.

title: Production Supervisor/Coordinator - Dry-Mix Mortar & Water-based Coatings Factory
description:
Core Responsibilities:

1. Production Operations & Management

  • Oversee daily production management for both dry-mix mortar and water-based coatings lines. Schedule production tasks according to plan, ensuring production targets are met on time, in quantity, and to quality standards.
  • Supervise the entire production process from material preparation, feeding, and mixing to packaging and palletizing, ensuring smooth and efficient operations at all stages.
  • Strictly execute the production schedule, optimize production cycle times, and improve equipment utilization and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).

2. Team Management & Development

  • Manage daily shift operations, including personnel scheduling, task assignment, work guidance, and on-site discipline supervision.
  • Organize and implement job skill training to enhance team members' operational skills, quality awareness, and safety mindset.
  • Conduct performance evaluations for shift personnel, providing continuous feedback and coaching to build a high-performance team.

3. Quality Management & Control

  • Strictly enforce standard operating procedures and work instructions to ensure process standardization and stability.
  • Monitor in-line product quality, perform regular checks at key quality control points, and prevent the occurrence of batch quality issues.
  • Collaborate with the Quality department to analyze, address, and track quality deviations in production, and implement corrective and preventive actions.

4. Safety Production & 5S Management

  • Act as the primary safety responsible person for the shift, implementing company safety rules and regulations, organizing safety training, and conducting hazard identification.
  • Ensure all employees strictly adhere to safe operating procedures, particularly those related to dust explosion prevention and chemical handling, to eliminate safety accidents.
  • Promote and maintain 5S management in the production area, creating a clean, orderly, and safe working environment.

5. Cost Control & Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor and analyze the consumption of raw materials, energy, and auxiliary supplies, striving to reduce production costs.
  • Assist in analyzing equipment failure causes to reduce unplanned downtime.
  • Proactively identify waste in the production process, actively participate in and lead continuous improvement activities (e.g., Kaizen), and propose合理化建议 (rationalization suggestions).

Mandatory Requirements:

  • College diploma or above in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Inorganic Non-metallic Materials, or related fields.
  • Minimum 5 years of production experience in the building materials industry, including at least 2 years in a Production Team Leader or Supervisor role. Must have production management experience in a dry-mix mortar or water-based coatings factory.
  • Familiar with the production processes, equipment principles, and operational procedures for dry-mix mortar/coatings (e.g., mixers, automatic packing machines, powder conveying systems, liquid mixing & dispersing equipment).
  • Strong team leadership, communication, coordination, and on-site problem-solving skills.
  • Strong quality awareness, cost consciousness, and safety mindset.
  • Ability to adapt to a factory work environment and handle work pressure.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior work experience with Sika or Saint-Gobain is highly preferred.

title: Industrial Director
description:
Industrial Director/Plant Director – Leading Global Tier-1 Automotive Systems Supplier

Greater Campinas

Please note: Given the complexity of this mandate, only candidates with proven plant leadership experience in Tier-1 auto parts environments will be considered.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly capable operations/industrial executive to assume the role of Industrial Director, leading a complex Tier-1 auto parts manufacturing site through a structured operational turnaround and long-term performance transformation.

This is an opportunity for an experienced Plant Manager, Senior Industrial Manager, or Industrial/Operations Director ready to step into a broader, strategic leadership role in a high-performance, global environment.

The context involves operational transformation, focusing on stabilizing processes, developing and strengthening teams, improving KPIs, and elevating manufacturing discipline.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead all plant operations across Production, Engineering, Maintenance, Quality, HSE, Supply Chain, HR, and CI.
  • Conduct a holistic diagnostic of operational gaps and drive a structured operational recovery plan.
  • Implement initiatives focused on process stability, cost efficiency, scrap/yield improvement, reliability, and labor productivity.
  • Build and reinforce leadership capabilities across the plant, promoting a culture of accountability, rigor, and continuous improvement.
  • Drive Lean, TPM, and other operational excellence methodologies with rigor and sustainability.
  • Ensure compliance with global standards in Quality, Safety, Governance, and ESG.
  • Manage stakeholder interactions with customers, suppliers, corporate functions, and global engineering teams.
  • Oversee KPIs, budgets, capex initiatives, and customer deliverables.

Mandatory Qualifications & Experience

  • Strong background in Tier-1 auto parts manufacturing (mandatory).
  • Experience in operational turnaround or performance recovery (e.g., process variability, quality issues, productivity challenges, organizational capability gaps).
  • Proven leadership of large teams in high-complexity, fast-paced industrial environments.
  • Solid foundation in Lean, CI, TPM, or equivalent methodologies.
  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field (required).
  • Advanced/Fluent English.

Leadership Profile

We are looking for a leader who combines strategic clarity with hands-on discipline, capable of stabilizing operations, developing teams, and delivering sustained performance improvement in a demanding tier-1 auto parts environment. Someone who thrives under complexity, communicates transparently, and brings operational rigor to daily execution.

If you bring the ability to set strategic direction while staying close to the shop floor and combine strategic clarity with real operational depth in demanding Tier-1 environments this is the kind of opportunity where your leadership can truly move the needle.

title: Production Supervisor/Coordinator - Dry-Mix Mortar & Water-Based Coatings Factory
description:
Core Responsibilities:

1. Production Operations & Management

  • Oversee daily production management for both dry-mix mortar and water-based coatings lines. Schedule production tasks according to plan, ensuring production targets are met on time, in quantity, and to quality standards.
  • Supervise the entire production process from material preparation, feeding, and mixing to packaging and palletizing, ensuring smooth and efficient operations at all stages.
  • Strictly execute the production schedule, optimize production cycle times, and improve equipment utilization and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).

2. Team Management & Development

  • Manage daily shift operations, including personnel scheduling, task assignment, work guidance, and on-site discipline supervision.
  • Organize and implement job skill training to enhance team members' operational skills, quality awareness, and safety mindset.
  • Conduct performance evaluations for shift personnel, providing continuous feedback and coaching to build a high-performance team.

3. Quality Management & Control

  • Strictly enforce standard operating procedures and work instructions to ensure process standardization and stability.
  • Monitor in-line product quality, perform regular checks at key quality control points, and prevent the occurrence of batch quality issues.
  • Collaborate with the Quality department to analyze, address, and track quality deviations in production, and implement corrective and preventive actions.

4. Safety Production & 5S Management

  • Act as the primary safety responsible person for the shift, implementing company safety rules and regulations, organizing safety training, and conducting hazard identification.
  • Ensure all employees strictly adhere to safe operating procedures, particularly those related to dust explosion prevention and chemical handling, to eliminate safety accidents.
  • Promote and maintain 5S management in the production area, creating a clean, orderly, and safe working environment.

5. Cost Control & Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor and analyze the consumption of raw materials, energy, and auxiliary supplies, striving to reduce production costs.
  • Assist in analyzing equipment failure causes to reduce unplanned downtime.
  • Proactively identify waste in the production process, actively participate in and lead continuous improvement activities (e.G., Kaizen), and propose合理化建议 (rationalization suggestions).

Mandatory Requirements:

  • College diploma or above in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Inorganic Non-metallic Materials, or related fields.
  • Minimum 5 years of production experience in the building materials industry, including at least 2 years in a Production Team Leader or Supervisor role. Must have production management experience in a dry-mix mortar or water-based coatings factory.
  • Familiar with the production processes, equipment principles, and operational procedures for dry-mix mortar/coatings (e.G., mixers, automatic packing machines, powder conveying systems, liquid mixing & dispersing equipment).
  • Strong team leadership, communication, coordination, and on-site problem-solving skills.
  • Strong quality awareness, cost consciousness, and safety mindset.
  • Ability to adapt to a factory work environment and handle work pressure.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior work experience with Sika or Saint-Gobain is highly preferred.

Estamos em busca de um profissional dinâmico e proativo para agregar ao time de Compras CSC, que é responsável pelas aquisições de materiais e serviços táticos e operacionais de nossos negócios.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Você focará em:

  • Trabalhar nas contratações da categoria de Serviços , podendo trafegar na compra de materiais, analisando o mercado e encontrando oportunidades internas;
  • Promover a integração com todos os departamentos da empresa, gerindo stakeholders (áreas requisitantes, fornecedores e demais áreas envolvidas no processo);
  • Atuar dedicadamente em promover redução de custos nos contratos atuais, desenvolvendo novas alternativas;
  • Criar acordos de fornecimento, através de contratos, com o objetivo de gerar economia nas negociações;
  • Garantir o cumprimento das metas de resultados estabelecidas para os processos da categoria, considerando os aspectos financeiros, qualitativos e quantitativos, mediante acompanhamento e controle dos indicadores de performance e tomando ações preventivas e corretivas necessárias à melhoria contínua;
  • Desenvolver relacionamento com os fornecedores;
  • Acompanhar a evolução dos preços praticados pelos fornecedores;
  • Apoiara liderança em iniciativas de melhoria de processos para transformar a eficiência e a eficácia das compras;
  • Garantir o cumprimento das políticas e diretrizes das empresas;
  • Manter a proximidade com as áreas de negócio e ter foco no cliente;
  • Ser referência para equipe quanto ao comportamento, atuando dentro dos valores da empresa;


Requisitos e qualificações:

Como requisitos básicos, você deve ter:


  • Superior completo em áreas relacionadas a administração, engenharia, afins;
  • Conhecimento emferramentas de Compras;
  • Experiência na Categoria de Serviços (diferencial);
  • Experiência em condução de Strategic Sourcing (diferencial);
  • Experiência em negociação de contratos de alto valores;
  • Experiência em abertura de custos;
  • Conhecimento avançado em negociação;
  • Conhecimento doprocesso e de tributação nas aquisições de serviços;
  • Construção de apresentações para report Gerencial;
  • Disponibilidadepara atuação em Campinas-SP.


Você se destaca se tiver:


  • Desejável conhecimento em ERP SAP;
  • Desejável conhecimento em Portal de Compras - Ariba, Coupa ou outros;
  • Conhecimento ServiceNow.


Informações adicionais:

Oferecemos uma proposta de remuneração fixa e variável competitiva, além de uma série de benefícios, veja alguns deles:


  • Plano de saúde
  • Plano odontológico
  • VA e VR valores competitivos com o mercado
  • Auxílio Farmácia
  • Licença familiar e Kit Ultra Família, 180 dias para licença maternidade e 20 dias para licença paternidade. Kit para mãe e bebê
  • Auxílio Creche 24 meses de reembolso para mães e pais
  • Auxílio ao filho com deficiência
  • Gympass
  • Previdência Privada
  • Programa de Pós-graduação e Idiomas e parcerias educacionais
  • Programas de saúde e bem-estar, quick-massage e ginastica laboral



Além disso tudo, incluímos também:


  • Trabalhar e trocar conhecimentos diários com um time referência no mercado
  • Ter a oportunidade de trabalhar em uma Holding que potencializa negócios que impactam a vida das pessoas e investe em segmentos essenciais para a sociedade

description:

Venha fazer parte do time da maior rede de joalherias da América Latina! Com mais de 60 anos de história, desenvolvemos um portfólio de marcas – Vivara, Life by Vivara, Vivara Watches, Vivara Fragrances e Vivara Accessories, com foco em joias de ouro, joias de prata, relógios e acessórios.

Na Vivara, acreditamos na inclusão e na diversidade, e as apoiamos em todas as suas formas de expressão para construir um lugar em que todas as pessoas se sintam bem-vindas. Recriminamos qualquer tipo de discriminação, seja por idade, orientação sexual, identidade ou expressão de gênero, cor, etnia, deficiência ou religião.

  • Garantir a montagem, organização, limpeza e reposição da vitrine;
  • Promover a adequada operação da loja.

  • Escolaridade necessária: Ensino Médio Completo - Obrigatório;

title: Consultor Pré-Vendas
description:
Como BDR Pré-Vendas , seu papel é essencial na geração e qualificação de oportunidades comerciais, garantindo que o time de Closers receba leads preparados e com fit real.


Empresa: DS.Marketing

Modalidade: CLT

Modelo de trabalho: 100% Presencial - Campinas/SP

a) segunda a sexta 08:00 às 16:12 e sábado 8:00 às 12:00 ou

b) segunda a sexta 12:48 às 21:00 e sábado 9:00 às 13:00


Responsabilidades

  • Entrar em contato com leads inbound e listas de prospecção , principalmente via ligação (discadora) e WhatsApp , buscando entender o momento e despertar o interesse em conhecer a DS.
  • Realizar follow-ups e cadências estruturadas , acompanhando os leads que demonstraram interesse inicial, mas ainda não marcaram reunião.

  • Monitorar suas métricas de performance , como volume de contatos, taxa de resposta, conversão em reuniões e comparecimento.
  • Participar ativamente dos treinamentos comerciais , desenvolvendo habilidades de comunicação, argumentação


Competências:

  • Comunicação clara e empática: capaz de gerar conexão com diferentes perfis e despertar interesse rapidamente.
  • Proatividade e curiosidade: busca entender o cliente e o produto, testando novas abordagens e aprendendo continuamente.
  • Resiliência: entende que o topo do funil envolve muitos “nãos” e mantém o foco e a energia.
  • Organização e disciplina: registra dados com precisão e segue o processo de qualificação.
  • Trabalho em equipe: colabora com marketing e vendas, entendendo que o resultado é coletivo.


Nossa Proposta

  • Remuneração Atrativa: (fixo + variável + bônus de performance superior)
  • Contratação: CLT
  • Cartão Flash Benefícios (VA/VR)
  • Vale Transporte

Vamos juntos!

title: Coordenador(A) De Food Safety (Temporário)
description:
About the role

Estamos buscando um(a) Coordenador(a) de Food Safety para atuar em um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, garantindo a implementação e manutenção dos programas de qualidade e segurança de alimentos na fábrica. Contrato temporário de 9 meses com chance de contratação ao final do contrato.


Key responsibilities

  • Garantir a implementação e manutenção dos programas de Food Safety e Qualidade na fábrica.
  • Promover treinamentos de HACCP para equipe HACCP e demais colaboradores.
  • Coordenar o manejo integrado de pragas.
  • Elaborar, implementar e registrar treinamentos da área de qualidade para todos os colaboradores.
  • Revisar e manter todos os Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (POP) da fábrica.
  • Atuar frente às não conformidades encontradas, utilizando ferramentas como 5W2H para análise de causa raiz.
  • Coordenar auditorias internas e externas, bem como planos de ação decorrentes de auditorias, reclamações de clientes ou não conformidades.
  • Gerenciar o sistema de reclamações de clientes.
  • Liderar a equipe HACCP e revisar estudos HACCP.
  • Garantir conformidade com normas governamentais, ambientais e de segurança industrial.


Qualifications and skills

  • Formação preferencial: Engenharia de Alimentos , Química ou Farmácia .
  • Certificações: HACCP , FSSC 22000 (obrigatória).
  • Experiência com auditorias internas e externas (relacionados à qualidade e segurança de alimentos).
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de análise de causa raiz (5W2H ).
  • Domínio de SAP e Excel (planilhas de capex, budget).
  • Conhecimento em sistemas globais e protocolos internacionais.
  • Inglês intermediário (leitura de documentação técnica e protocolos globais). Espanhol será considerado diferencial.
  • Pensamento crítico e capacidade analítica.
  • Inteligência emocional para lidar com problemas e manter a calma.
  • Proatividade, resiliência e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Capacidade de priorizar tarefas em ambiente dinâmico.
  • Visão prática: presença no chão de fábrica, não apenas atividades administrativas.


About Kerry

Kerry is the world's leading taste and nutrition company for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical industries. Every day we partner with customers to create healthier, tastier and more sustainable products that are consumed by billions of people across the world. Our vision is to be our customers' most valued partner, creating a world of sustainable nutrition. A career with Kerry offers you an opportunity to shape the future of food while providing you opportunities to explore and grow in a truly global environment.

title: Senior Director - Latam Delivery Head (Payments Industry)
description:

  • Strong understanding of delivery financials, forecasting & commercial contracts


  • Proven line management experience, developing high performing teams


  • Excellent written & spoken English and Spanish


  • Availability to work in Campinas on a hybrid mode


  • Flexibility to travel.

title: Analista De Cobrança E Retenção
description:
Analista de Cobrança e Retenção – DS.Marketing


Como Analista de Cobrança e Retenção, você será responsável por conduzir o relacionamento com clientes em momentos críticos do ciclo, especialmente em situações de inadimplência, desalinhamento de expectativas ou perda momentânea de percepção de valor.


Seu papel é estratégico: garantir que o cliente mantenha clareza sobre seu plano de crescimento, entenda os próximos passos e execute corretamente a jornada para renovar e recomprar com previsibilidade.


Nesta função, você atuará com abordagem consultiva, combinando princípios de Customer Success, operações de cobrança, recuperação de crédito e gestão de objeções, sempre com foco na manutenção da receita e saúde da carteira.


Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir contatos ativos e receptivos com clientes em atraso, risco de churn ou perda de percepção de valor.
  • Identificar a causa raiz da inadimplência (financeira, técnica, operacional ou de expectativa) e propor caminhos realistas de regularização.
  • Resgatar a visão estratégica do cliente, conectando o plano contratado aos resultados esperados.
  • Estruturar negociações e acordos financeiros que permitam continuidade saudável do contrato.
  • Controlar objeções com técnica e empatia, garantindo que o cliente se sinta acompanhado e orientado.
  • Executar rotinas de cobrança consultiva, evitando processos mecânicos e focando no impacto do plano no negócio do cliente.
  • Acompanhar SLAs de contatos, follow-ups, acordos e compromissos assumidos.
  • Mapear riscos de cancelamento e agir preventivamente para evitar churn.
  • Alimentar o CRM com histórico, status, acordos e próximos passos, mantendo previsibilidade e organização.
  • Colaborar com times internos (CS, financeiro, comercial e operações) na construção de rotinas que melhorem retenção e adimplência.
  • Gerar percepções qualitativas sobre comportamento dos clientes, objeções recorrentes e oportunidades de melhoria no produto/atendimento.


Competências desejadas

  • Comunicação clara e empática: saber conduzir conversas difíceis sem perder a conexão.
  • Sem medo do telefone, nosso clientes quer ser ouvido! Comunicação em voz é mais eficiente!
  • Perfil consultivo: entender o contexto e orientar com visão de negócio.
  • Resiliência emocional: lidar bem com cenários críticos, objeções, frustrações e pressão.
  • Negociação e argumentação: construir acordos viáveis e sustentáveis.
  • Organização e precisão: registrar dados e cumprir processos com excelência.
  • Visão sistêmica: enxergar a jornada completa do cliente e o impacto da retenção na empresa.
  • Disciplina e compromisso: acompanhar pendências, prazos e acordos até a resolução.
  • Colaboração: trabalhar próximo a CS, Financeiro e Comercial para garantir resultado coletivo.


Sobre a DS.Marketing

Empresa especialista em impulsionar vendas no varejo por meio de tecnologia, dados e automação. Democratizamos o acesso ao marketing digital para o empreendor do Brasil profundo!


Modalidade de contratação: CLT

Se você quer atuar na linha de frente da saúde da carteira, garantir a continuidade dos clientes e gerar impacto real no varejo brasileiro, essa vaga é para você.

title: Gerente De Vendas

We are a leading global technology company operating in the high-growth sector of On-Demand Consumer Services . Leveraging innovative technology and proven strategies from a global digital commerce leader, we are driving massive international expansion. We offer a challenging, fast-paced environment and an unparalleled opportunity to build and scale a business from the ground up in new markets.

  • Team Building and Empowerment : Assist our organization in establishing a local sales team , building from scratch to drive business expansion. Rapidly enhance the team's capabilities and ensure the achievement of business goals through systematic one-on-one and group training models.

  • Time Management and Optimization : Clearly define time management priorities for the role and different levels, and optimize personal time management based on actual circumstances.

  • Motivation and Resilience : Demonstrate strong ambition and professionalism, willingness to challenge oneself, and the ability to handle work-related pressure effectively.
  • Language Proficiency : Fluent in English (speaking, listening, reading, and writing), with the ability to adapt to long-term overseas work.

Join us to witness the rapid growth of a global digital giant's international business expansion and experience firsthand the industry transformation and growth miracles. You will collaborate with a world-class, diverse team, fostering innovative thinking, expanding your international perspective, and deepening your expertise. This is not just a job—it's an unparalleled opportunity to achieve personal growth, realize your self-worth, and drive global business innovation.

title: Engenheiro Mecânico
description:
Mechanical Engineering


Looking for:

We are looking for a motivated and hands-on Mechanical Engineer to join our team. This position

will provide you with the opportunity to work on exciting development projects, helping to create and

bring innovative products to life. You will apply your experience in mechanical design, CAD modeling,

prototyping, while working alongside cross-functional teams to ensure the product meets all

requirements from concept to production.

The Mechanical Engineer Reporting to the Staff (USA), Engineer out of Campinas.


The Candidate:

You have experience engineering new products and/or handling touchpoints throughout the

concept to manufacturing journey. You’ve either built or supported bringing new products to the

world, handling mechanical engineering design, research, testing, prototyping, and validation.

You have experience working with mass manufactured product and are familiar with a variety of

materials. You’re willing to research, learn, adapt and take initiative but not afraid of taking on

challenges.

The Qualifications :

  • 3+ years of experience in product development and mechanical engineering. Must have a portfolio with previously launched and manufactured products.
  • Proven experience within consumer electronics /household appliance industry and related industries focused on mechanical engineering
  • Engineering degree preferably Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
  • Highly proficient and deeply familiar with CAD tools (Solidworks, Onshape, or Creo) and prior experience with a variety of prototyping approaches
  • Hands-on experience with prototyping, 3D printing, or other fabrication tools is a plus.
  • Experience with a wide range of materials (plastics, metals, rubbers) and knowledge informing the material selection process.
  • Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach challenges methodically applying analytical skills with proactive issue resolution- creating and guiding root cause analysis and DOE’s.
  • Passion for product development: Interest in consumer product design, manufacturing, and mechanical systems.
  • Strong communication skills: Ability to work well with cross-functional teams and convey technical concepts clearly. Strong Presentation skills - especially conveying technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Excellent project management skills- with experience tracking numerous development projects simultaneously.
  • Ability to travel to Asia including Hong Kong, China, Vietnam, South Korea, and Taiwan.
  • Ability to work in English


The Job:

As Mechanical Engineer, you will:

  • Help to lead (and lead) development work from product definition through manufacturing.
  • Communicate progress to team members and project requirements for development and manufacturing.
  • Work closely with NYC and Asia teams to communicate and determine direction & solve development problems as they arise.
  • Collaborate with NY/Asia engineering teams to ensure the engineering designs meet client requirements and design intent.

The Responsibilities:

  • Assist and lead Mechanical Design: Support the design and development of product by creating 3D CAD models, producing engineering drawings, and necessary documentation. i.E. lead mechanical design engineering of a product from inception to manufacturing.
  • Prototyping & Testing: Build and test prototypes to validate designs, including hands-on assembly and working with external suppliers for prototype development.
  • Ensure efficient product development cycle with detailed prototyping, testing, and validation throughout the process.
  • Ensuring designs align with performance, material, and cost targets determined for each project.
  • Collaborate with Teams: Work closely with the engineering and design teams to ensure that products meet functional, material, and aesthetic goals. Communicate with marketing, operations, and manufacturing teams to align on project updates and requirements.
  • Support and Create Documentation: Assist with maintaining and updating CAD models and related product documentation (3D, 2D, etc.).
  • Product Testing: Help conduct off-tool and in-market sample testing, participate in troubleshooting and debugging design issues, and recommend improvements.
  • Learn from Experienced Engineers: Continue to build experience in various materials and different stages of product development while learning best practices from senior and staff engineers.
  • Support Supply Chain Efforts: Collaborate with the sourcing and supply chain teams to help gather information and support procurement of materials and components.
  • Providing technical feedback and assets to support sourcing & supply chain teams, working closely with manufacturing engineers and suppliers.
  • Handle multiple projects and work independently.
  • Provide Engineering Support and Analysis to NY and HK engineering teams.
  • Build inhouse prototypes or scope external partners to prototype designs.

title: Industrial Director
description:
Industrial Director/Plant Director – Leading Global Tier-1 Automotive Systems Supplier

Greater Campinas

Please note: Given the complexity of this mandate, only candidates with proven plant leadership experience in Tier-1 auto parts environments will be considered.


About the Role


We are seeking a highly capable operations/industrial executive to assume the role of Industrial Director , leading a complex Tier-1 auto parts manufacturing site through a structured operational turnaround and long-term performance transformation.


This is an opportunity for an experienced Plant Manager , Senior Industrial Manager , or Industrial/Operations Director ready to step into a broader, strategic leadership role in a high-performance, global environment.


The context involves operational transformation, focusing on stabilizing processes, developing and strengthening teams, improving KPIs, and elevating manufacturing discipline.


Key Responsibilities


  • Lead all plant operations across Production, Engineering, Maintenance, Quality, HSE, Supply Chain, HR, and CI.
  • Conduct a holistic diagnostic of operational gaps and drive a structured operational recovery plan.
  • Implement initiatives focused on process stability, cost efficiency, scrap/yield improvement, reliability, and labor productivity.
  • Build and reinforce leadership capabilities across the plant, promoting a culture of accountability, rigor, and continuous improvement.
  • Drive Lean, TPM, and other operational excellence methodologies with rigor and sustainability.
  • Ensure compliance with global standards in Quality, Safety, Governance, and ESG.
  • Manage stakeholder interactions with customers, suppliers, corporate functions, and global engineering teams.
  • Oversee KPIs, budgets, capex initiatives, and customer deliverables.


Mandatory Qualifications & Experience


  • Strong background in Tier-1 auto parts manufacturing (mandatory).
  • Experience in operational turnaround or performance recovery (e.G., process variability, quality issues, productivity challenges, organizational capability gaps).
  • Proven leadership of large teams in high-complexity, fast-paced industrial environments.
  • Solid foundation in Lean, CI, TPM, or equivalent methodologies.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field (required).
  • Advanced/Fluent English.


Leadership Profile


We are looking for a leader who combines strategic clarity with hands-on discipline, capable of stabilizing operations, developing teams, and delivering sustained performance improvement in a demanding tier-1 auto parts environment. Someone who thrives under complexity, communicates transparently, and brings operational rigor to daily execution.


If you bring the ability to set strategic direction while staying close to the shop floor and combine strategic clarity with real operational depth in demanding Tier-1 environments this is the kind of opportunity where your leadership can truly move the needle.

Requisitos da vaga

Quais serão seus desafios no dia-a-dia:

  • Desenvolver, testar e solucionar problemas em pilhas de protocolo para redes móveis 5G, com foco estratégico em soluções baseadas na arquitetura Open RAN, garantindo código robusto e de alto desempenho;

  • Atuar em integrações, testes de desempenho e interoperabilidade de soluções 5G Open RAN, propondo otimização de parâmetros e implementando melhorias funcionais e de desempenho que impulsionam a eficiência da rede;

  • Disponibilidade para atuação híbrida 2x por semana em Campinas;

  • Conhecimentos Técnicos:

    1. Proficiência em C/C++ e experiência com programação para sistemas embarcados em ambiente Linux;

    2. Conhecimento sobre comunicações digitais (modulação, codificação de canal, etc), processamento digital de sinais e camada física de modo geral;

    3. Conhecimento em tecnologia 5G (NR) e arquitetura Open RAN;

    4. Familiaridade com as normas do 3GPP e especificações da O-RAN Alliance;

    5. Familiaridade com redes de computadores, principalmente em ambiente Linux, incluindo ferramentas como tcpdump, traceroute, iptables, netcat, namespaces, etc;

  • Inglês avançado ou fluente (leitura, escrita e conversação técnica).

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Pós-graduação (Mestrado ou Doutorado) em andamento;

  • Experiência prática com ferramentas de análise de tráfego e emulação de rede (ex: Wireshark, UERANSIM, srsRAN, OpenAirInterface);

  • Conhecimento em ferramentas e algoritmos de otimização de redes móveis;
